infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PASER records your route while you run so you can claim the area you enclose. Your route is only tracked during an active run.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PASER records your route while you run so you can claim the area you enclose. Background access only keeps an active run recording when the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion data verifies your runs are on foot.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PASER lets you take a photo to add to your run post or to use as your club photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PASER lets you choose photos to add to your run post or to use as your club photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PASER saves your run card to your photos when you tap Save on the share screen.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PASER saves your finished runs to Apple Health as running workouts when you turn on Health sync. PASER never reads your health data.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PASER never reads your Apple Health data. Health access is used only to save the runs you finish as workouts.
